+import base64
+import hashlib
+import os
+import secrets
+import threading
+import time
+import webbrowser
+from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
+from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlencode, urlparse
+
+import requests
+
+AUTH0_DOMAIN = os.environ.get("AUTH0_DOMAIN")
+AUTH0_CLIENT_ID = os.environ.get("AUTH0_CLIENT_ID")
+AUTH0_AUDIENCE = os.environ.get("AUTH0_AUDIENCE")
+AUTH0_CALLBACK_HOST = os.environ.get("AUTH0_CALLBACK_HOST", "127.0.0.1")
+AUTH0_CALLBACK_PORT = int(os.environ.get("AUTH0_CALLBACK_PORT", "8765"))
+AUTH0_SCOPE = os.environ.get("AUTH0_SCOPE", "openid profile email")
+
+
+def _b64url(data: bytes) -> str:
+    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(data).decode().rstrip("=")
+
+
+def generate_pkce_pair():
+    verifier = _b64url(secrets.token_bytes(32))
+    challenge = _b64url(hashlib.sha256(verifier.encode()).digest())
+    return verifier, challenge
+
+
+class _CallbackHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+    code = None
+    error = None
+
+    def do_GET(self):
+        parsed = urlparse(self.path)
+        params = parse_qs(parsed.query)
+        if "error" in params:
+            _CallbackHandler.error = params.get("error_description", [params["error"][0]])[0]
+        else:
+            _CallbackHandler.code = params.get("code", [None])[0]
+        self.send_response(200)
+        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
+        self.end_headers()
+        self.wfile.write(b"<html><body>You may close this window.</body></html>")
+
+    def log_message(self, format, *args):
+        return
+
+
+def _start_local_server():
+    server = HTTPServer((AUTH0_CALLBACK_HOST, AUTH0_CALLBACK_PORT), _CallbackHandler)
+    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
+    thread.start()
+    return server
+
+
+def login(timeout_seconds: int = 300):
+    if not AUTH0_DOMAIN or not AUTH0_CLIENT_ID:
+        raise RuntimeError("AUTH0_DOMAIN and AUTH0_CLIENT_ID are required")
+
+    verifier, challenge = generate_pkce_pair()
+    redirect_uri = f"http://{AUTH0_CALLBACK_HOST}:{AUTH0_CALLBACK_PORT}/callback"
+    server = _start_local_server()
+    try:
+        auth_url = f"https://{AUTH0_DOMAIN}/authorize?{urlencode({'response_type': 'code', 'client_id': AUTH0_CLIENT_ID, 'redirect_uri': redirect_uri, 'scope': AUTH0_SCOPE, 'code_challenge': challenge, 'code_challenge_method': 'S256', 'state': secrets.token_urlsafe(16), **({'audience': AUTH0_AUDIENCE} if AUTH0_AUDIENCE else {})})}"
+        webbrowser.open(auth_url)
+        deadline = time.time() + timeout_seconds
+        while time.time() < deadline:
+            if _CallbackHandler.error:
+                raise RuntimeError(_CallbackHandler.error)
+            if _CallbackHandler.code:
+                break
+            time.sleep(0.2)
+        if not _CallbackHandler.code:
+            raise TimeoutError("Timed out waiting for authorization code")
+
+        token_resp = requests.post(
+            f"https://{AUTH0_DOMAIN}/oauth/token",
+            json={
+                "grant_type": "authorization_code",
+                "client_id": AUTH0_CLIENT_ID,
+                "code": _CallbackHandler.code,
+                "code_verifier": verifier,
+                "redirect_uri": redirect_uri,
+            },
+            timeout=30,
+        )
+        token_resp.raise_for_status()
+        return token_resp.json()
+    finally:
+        server.shutdown()
+        server.server_close()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    print(login())
*** End Patch

+import os

+
+import requests
+
+
+GOOGLE_OIDC_USERINFO_URL = "https://openidconnect.googleapis.com/v1/userinfo"

+        "full_name": claims.get("name"),

+        "family_name": claims.get("family_name"),
+        "picture_url": claims.get("picture"),
+        "locale": claims.get("locale"),
+        "raw_claims": claims,
+    }

+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+GOOGLE_TOKEN_ENDPOINT = "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token"
+
+
+def exchange_authorization_code(
+    code: str,
+    redirect_uri: str,
+    client_id: Optional[str] = None,
+    client_secret: Optional[str] = None,
+) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    client_id = client_id or os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID")
+    client_secret = client_secret or os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET")
+    if not client_id or not client_secret:
+        raise ValueError("GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET are required")
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        GOOGLE_TOKEN_ENDPOINT,
+        data={
+            "code": code,
+            "client_id": client_id,
+            "client_secret": client_secret,
+            "redirect_uri": redirect_uri,
+            "grant_type": "authorization_code",
+        },
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return response.json()
+
+
+def oauth_callback_handler(event: Dict[str, Any], context: Any = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    params = event.get("queryStringParameters") or {}
+    code = params.get("code")
+    redirect_uri = params.get("redirect_uri") or os.environ.get("GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI")
+
+    if not code:
+        return {"statusCode": 400, "body": json.dumps({"error": "missing_code"})}
+    if not redirect_uri:
+        return {"statusCode": 400, "body": json.dumps({"error": "missing_redirect_uri"})}
+
+    try:
+        tokens = exchange_authorization_code(code=code, redirect_uri=redirect_uri)
+        return {"statusCode": 200, "body": json.dumps(tokens)}
+    except requests.HTTPError as exc:
+        body = exc.response.text if exc.response is not None else str(exc)
+        return {"statusCode": 502, "body": json.dumps({"error": "token_exchange_failed", "details": body})}
+    except Exception as exc:
+        return {"statusCode": 500, "body": json.dumps({"error": "internal_error", "details": str(exc)})}

+    client_id = client_id or os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID")
+    client_secret = client_secret or os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET")
+    if not client_id or not client_secret:
+        raise ValueError("GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET are required")
+

+        data={

+            "client_id": client_id,
+            "client_secret": client_secret,
+            "redirect_uri": redirect_uri,
+            "grant_type": "authorization_code",
+        },
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return response.json()
+
+
+def oauth_callback_handler(event: Dict[str, Any], context: Any = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    params = event.get("queryStringParameters") or {}
+    code = params.get("code")
+    redirect_uri = params.get("redirect_uri") or os.environ.get("GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI")
+
+    if not code:
+        return {"statusCode": 400, "body": json.dumps({"error": "missing_code"})}
+    if not redirect_uri:
+        return {"statusCode": 400, "body": json.dumps({"error": "missing_redirect_uri"})}
+
+    try:
+        tokens = exchange_authorization_code(code=code, redirect_uri=redirect_uri)
+        return {"statusCode": 200, "body": json.dumps(tokens)}
+    except requests.HTTPError as exc:
+        body = exc.response.text if exc.response is not None else str(exc)
+        return {"statusCode": 502, "body": json.dumps({"error": "token_exchange_failed", "details": body})}
+    except Exception as exc:
+        return {"statusCode": 500, "body": json.dumps({"error": "internal_error", "details": str(exc)})}
